key_insight: Explicit boundary-condition inputs sharply improve aerodynamic surrogate accuracy, but generalization to unseen enclosures and boundary layouts remains difficult.
engineering_relevance: AeroZoo tests whether fast CFD surrogates can handle new shapes and flow domains under fully specified physical conditions.
method: Generate 3,815 time-mean unsteady RANS solutions with a transition model across seven geometry families and eight enclosure configurations.
Represent each problem using boundary meshes grouped by condition type, prescribed values and fluid properties.
Evaluate two tasks using engineering metrics and 22 frozen, geometry-disjoint splits.
evidence_signal: The canonical benchmark contains 2,816 stable-mean cases; boundary-condition tokens reduce GeoTransolver's median velocity error from 76.9% to 8.4% of inlet speed in single-seed runs, while ISLA reaches 5.3% over four seeds.
watch_item: On the same test samples, holding out enclosures or boundary-condition layouts raises ISLA's error 2.4–9.2 times, highlighting deployment risks beyond familiar flow domains.
paper_title: AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics
